rationale: Kelso Valley is CIM's label for ReNu Resources LLC and the Onyx Ranch land/water/renewables investment, not an operating company or Permanent Power asset. Components were sold in 2008, 2013 and 2014, but CIM still reported oversight in 2021 and no later primary exit was found. Correct identity/scope and set ownership/status UNRESOLVED.

identityResolution.permanentPower: Separate 2026 CIM power PortCo built around disclosed Westlands assets; no verified alias, ownership, operating, transfer or successor link.

owners.transactionState: 2021 OVERSIGHT VERIFIED; later exit not found

ownershipResolution.conclusion: CIM and RRG were ReNu co-venturers; current stakes/ownership are UNRESOLVED. Permanent Power has no verified role.

operatingResolution.business: Land/water rights, irrigation, agriculture/grazing and proposed wind/solar
operatingResolution.customersOfftakers: No energy customer/PPA verified; asset buyers were Vernon, Rosedale and California State Parks.

operatingResolution.status: Residual ReNu assets/rights and current ownership UNRESOLVED; no operating company verified
assets: Wind: ~30,000 acres sold to Vernon for $42m in 2008; ReNu exited development; later status unresolved.
Solar: 60 MW/500-acre Weldon Solar reached a 2010 NOP only; its parcels later entered Rosedale's water project.
Water: 3,300-acre Onyx property sold to Rosedale in 2013 for reported $25m; the current 4,109-acre project operates in 2026.
Land/agriculture: State Parks bought 50 parcels/~26,000 acres in December 2014; residual parcels/rights unresolved.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No later sale, merger, recapitalization, Permanent Power transfer/rebrand or pending deal found. Final ReNu exit, residual assets and Weldon disposition remain UNRESOLVED.
